data.standardized_narrative: In 2016, Syndicate 1176 reported a gross release of GBP 2.6 million in technical reserves related to prior periods. This favorable development was predominantly driven by the nuclear liability class. The report also noted prior year strengthening due to Mexican claims from 2008 and 2010, and specific losses in 2015 from a fire in France, dust contamination in the Netherlands, and a dropped steam generator in France.
